name: 老人福祉基金を設置
summary: 区の社会福祉基金条例に、老人福祉基金を加えます。基金の額は1,000,000円で、区が行う老人福祉事業の費用に充てます。
changes: 老人福祉基金を新たに設置する
区が行う老人福祉事業の費用に充てる
who: 老人福祉事業の利用者
why: 老人福祉基金を設置するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Establishes a fund for elderly welfare
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Taito City Social Welfare Fund Ordinance
en.summary: Adds a fund for elderly welfare to the ward's Social Welfare Fund Ordinance. The fund will amount to ¥1,000,000 and will be used to cover the costs of elderly welfare programs carried out by the ward.
changes: Establishes a new fund for elderly welfare
Uses the fund to cover the costs of elderly welfare programs carried out by the ward
en.why: The ward says this is to establish a fund for elderly welfare.
